name: Remotion
summary: React framework for making videos programmatically: compose, preview and render video from code or with a coding agent.
description: Make videos programmatically with React: compositions built from components, previewed in the Player and Remotion Studio, rendered locally, on Lambda, on Vercel or client-side, and batch-rendered on your own infrastructure. The same code supports interactive drag-and-drop editing and agentic workflows that turn an idea into a video with a coding agent. 1000+ documentation pages cover components, elements, effects, transitions, captions, fonts, rendering and Node.js APIs; a free license covers individuals and companies of up to 3 people, larger teams need a company license.
contains: make videos agentically with a coding agent, interactively with drag and drop, or programmatically in code
React code is the source of truth; switch workflow at any point
render locally, on Lambda, on Vercel or client-side; batch-render millions of videos on your own infrastructure
build design systems of animated assets and video applications
1000+ documentation pages: components, elements, effects, transitions, captions, fonts, rendering
documentation at remotion.dev/docs; API reference at remotion.dev/api
free license for individuals and companies of up to 3 people, unlimited commercial use
company license for 4+ people: $0.01 per render, $100/mo minimum (Remotion for Automators)
